summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.33/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.33 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 18, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since May 22. AAA figures put the statewide average 37¢ higher than a week ago, 52¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.50 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($4.08) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.53).
